lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the torso; spacing is relatively uniform with a slight decrease in interval distance moving from the anterior to the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 6th vertical line from the anterior, splitting approximately 70% of the way up the torso toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Dashed segments are observed on the 3rd and 5th lines from the anterior, which terminate before reaching the ventral fringe; the 10th and 11th lines exhibit abbreviated vertical lengths compared to the central grouping.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast circular white spots are located on the lateral posterior haunch, positioned midway between the dorsal line and the knee joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two haunch spots are horizontally aligned, forming a short geometric parallel to the ground plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a spiraled lyrate curvature, projecting upwards and outwards from the skull base before curving inwards towards the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.8 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 12% of the total vertical length of the visible horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent white spots on the lower muzzle/cheek area and a distinct white chevron-like band between the eyes; presence of a long dark-brown ventral fringe and a white dorsal mane.
